waveform_generation_contract.architectural_rule: VALIDATE EACH INPUT GENERATION WHEN IT BECOMES VALID. DO NOT RESCAN AN UNCHANGED VALID GENERATION ON EVERY INFERENCE.
waveform_generation_contract.storage_model: One existing resident waveform buffer and its existing separate transport staging payload; no new double buffering or atomic replacement design.

states.EMPTY: New runtime: no generation, no receipt and no leases. Retained resident bytes cannot imply validity.
states.WRITING: A new generation owns the upload/acquisition attempt or resident mutation; prior receipt revoked. No inference lease. Staging reception may use this state before any resident byte is written.
states.UNVALIDATED: Expected bytes are complete and mutators are quiescent, but validation/publication is incomplete. Validator retains exclusive control; no inference lease.
states.VALID: Complete generation-bound receipt published atomically after all producer-specific checks; no mutation owner. Buffer is immutable until explicit invalidation.
states.INVALID: Failed, partial-aborted, cancelled, superseded, reset-expired or externally corrupted generation. No receipt or inference lease; this ID cannot return to VALID.

WAVEFORM_GENERATION_ID.identity: Opaque runtime-epoch plus internally owned monotonically increasing unsigned 64-bit generation counter. Host uploadSequence/request sequence and content CRC/SHA are not generation IDs.
WAVEFORM_GENERATION_ID.advance: Every admitted recognizable new upload attempt and every other new resident mutation/acquisition intent consumes a fresh counter value, even with identical bytes or reused host sequence. Staging, copying, validation and publication for one attempt keep the same ID.
WAVEFORM_GENERATION_ID.attempt_boundary: Serialized parser recognizes UploadWaveform at the first available command-type identification, at latest the complete header and before payload reception; unsupported version/length and subsequent frame errors cannot bypass attempt invalidation. Unrecognizable/truncated framing never publishes a generation.
WAVEFORM_GENERATION_ID.reset: Receipt, leases, writer ownership and producer validity start EMPTY in every new runtime. Epoch denotes that runtime instance; equality is scoped to it. Never restore or compare pre-reset receipts/tokens as current, even if PSRAM bytes or numeric counter values repeat.
WAVEFORM_GENERATION_ID.exhaustion: Counter does not wrap, recycle an ID or cause ABA equality. Exhaustion fails closed and prevents new publication; fresh runtime must begin EMPTY.
WAVEFORM_GENERATION_ID.cross_runtime_tokens: No persisted or host-issued generation token may establish current validity. If implementation cannot enforce runtime scoping and reject stale tokens, STOP.

receipt_binding: generation ID and current runtime epoch
resident base, exact sample count and byte count, format/sample-rate/channel contract
upload raw/resident CRC and retained declared SHA where applicable
finite validation and canonical discriminator where applicable
waveform_generation_contract.serialized_ownership: Retain the current single application command owner. Parser admission and all resident writes serialize with inference input consumption. USB traffic may queue in separate transport buffers during a lease; no concurrent parser admission, resident mutation or receipt replacement is allowed.
mutation_rule: Before any first resident-byte write, obtain exclusive mutation admission with no inference lease; retire the prior VALID receipt and clear all upload/acquisition compatibility validity flags.
Bind a fresh generation ID, producer and exact buffer range; WRITING prevents all leases. Every alias, diagnostic injector, DMA destination and external raw write must follow the same rule.
Complete writes, revoke mutable aliases/stop DMA ownership, transition to UNVALIDATED, validate the producer contract and atomically publish the receipt with VALID.
Any failure leaves the new ID INVALID and the old generation retired. A successful reupload is a new ID; INVALID cannot be rehabilitated.
Uncoordinated external writes invalidate evidence and cannot be followed by inference using an old receipt. Debugger halt alone does not revoke validity; any enabled unmediated writer requires STOP.

lease.at_waveform_ready_START: Generation is VALID, producer matches requested input, receipt binds the exact buffer/count/format, and no mutation owner exists. START stays at the existing waveform-ready boundary. Acquire/check and snapshot the lease inside the timed route before any frontend read.
lease.ownership: At most one inference input lease; all mutators and parser admissions are excluded until required input consumption is complete. Metadata checks are bounded generation/state/producer/pointer/length checks, not waveform scans.
lease.during_consumption: Generation ID, state, producer, buffer and ownership remain unchanged while the frontend consumes the waveform. Validate the same token after consumption and release ownership safely within the measured route; all frontend failure exits release without reviving invalid state.
lease.result_identity: Copy the receipt CRC/SHA metadata into the existing result fields using the leased snapshot. Receipt retirement later cannot relabel that result. Do not change saveResult, repeat comparison, result schema or publication.
lease.cost: Checks, receipt metadata copying, synchronization, token checks and release have nonzero unmeasured cost. Required input ownership work remains within waveform-ready -> ResultReady.
lease.concurrency_limit: No new asynchronous input writer or dispatcher behavior is authorized. If exclusive ownership cannot be maintained with minimal lifecycle hooks, STOP.

waveform_generation_contract.invalid_upload_semantics: Invalidate old generation at admitted upload-attempt start, before staging or resident mutation. Partial/error/abort/disconnect leaves no new VALID input and never falls back to the old receipt; parser restart creates another fresh ID. A still-incomplete upload stays non-VALID and cannot run inference. Existing last published results retain their ordinary behavior independently of input validity.
waveform_generation_contract.writer_coverage: UPLOAD_COPY and PDM_PCM_TO_FLOAT are current direct resident writers; transport-attempt hooks, legacy consumers, diagnostics/injection, fixture loading, startup, mutable aliases, future line/I2S and coordinated external writes must all be covered. Stop on any uncovered writer or scope expansion.

flow: Recognizable new upload attempt -> fresh G, revoke old validity/receipt, WRITING before staging or any resident mutation.
Receive exactly 384060 payload bytes (60 metadata + 384000 raw); complete receive -> UNVALIDATED; reject incomplete/unsupported framing.
Preserve H1CP framing/version/length and payload CRC validation; validate exact current metadata contract and retain declared raw CRC and SHA bytes.
Compute the existing full CRC of 384000 staged raw bytes once when this check is reached; require equality with declared raw CRC.
With the same G under exclusive mutation ownership, WRITING -> complete unchanged memcpy into resident waveform -> UNVALIDATED with no active writer.

Require all 96000 resident float samples finite and copy completion. Validate actual resident CRC against the same qualified raw/declared CRC once before VALID; this relocates the earliest legacy resident identity check to generation publication.
Preserve current canonicalByteMatch discriminator (canonical CRC, exact retained declared SHA and complete canonical byte equality where that conditional test applies).
Bind complete receipt to G and atomically publish VALID/waveform-ready; repeated uploaded inference leases G with bounded metadata/ownership checks only.

declared raw CRC and existing raw-byte full CRC equality
complete exact resident copy and resident CRC equality before publication
current conditional canonical CRC/SHA/byte discriminator and canonical-required consumer guards
uploaded_waveform_validation_contract.resident_integrity: The receipt qualifies actual resident bytes, not merely the transport payload. One once-per-generation post-copy resident CRC check preserves the old resident identity rejection. Do not infer correct resident copy from gUpload.valid or staged CRC alone.

FULL_RAW_WAVEFORM_CRC_SCANS_PER_NEW_UPLO.meaning: Existing staged raw-payload CRC only; early-rejected attempts may have zero and never VALID.

FULL_RESIDENT_WAVEFORM_CRC_SCANS_PER_VAL.meaning: Move the earliest legacy resident CRC check before publication. It is separate from the existing staged raw scan and never repeated for inference.

CRC_scan_accounting.no_arbitrary_extra_scans: For a successful upload followed by inference, the two generation-establishment CRC scans correspond to the existing staged raw scan plus first legacy resident scan. No mandatory additional full raw pass, SHA computation, new CRC algorithm or accelerator is invented.

uploaded_waveform_validation_contract.SHA_contract: Upload SHA is host-declared metadata retained/echoed today, not board-computed or cryptographically verified against content. Retain its exact value and declaration status; no new full waveform SHA scan is required. Never claim board SHA verification.
uploaded_waveform_validation_contract.identity_rejection_scope: IDENTITY_MISMATCH_ACCEPTED=0 covers required raw/resident CRC equality and required fixture/canonical identity guards. Generic finite noncanonical uploads remain permitted. A false canonicalByteMatch is not itself generic upload rejection; do not turn declared SHA echo into a new content-SHA gate.

per_upload_counters.UPLOAD_GENERATIONS_CREATED: Cumulative admitted recognizable upload attempts, including failed/partial attempts, with exactly one fresh ID per attempt.
per_upload_counters.UPLOAD_GENERATIONS_VALIDATED: Cumulative upload receipt publications; increments once per ID only after every required check.
per_upload_counters.FULL_RAW_WAVEFORM_CRC_SCANS_PER_NEW_UPLO: Actual existing staged raw full scan: 1 if reached, otherwise 0; per-ID counters distinguish early failures.
per_upload_counters.FULL_RAW_WAVEFORM_CRC_BYTES_PER_NEW_UPLO: 384000 if the raw scan completes, otherwise actual bytes processed; failed/incomplete scans cannot publish VALID.
per_upload_counters.FULL_RESIDENT_WAVEFORM_CRC_SCANS_PER_VAL: Exactly 1 completed prepublication resident scan for each successful uploaded ID; failures retain actual work counts.
per_upload_counters.VALID_GENERATIONS: Cumulative VALID publication events across producers, at most one publication per generation ID; not a current occupancy count.
per_upload_counters.INVALID_GENERATIONS: Cumulative IDs terminally invalidated/failed/retired, counted once per ID; excludes initial EMPTY. A previously published generation may later retire.
per_upload_counters.CURRENT_WAVEFORM_GENERATION_STATE: Current state, producer, ID, writer/lease ownership and receipt binding must be observable with bounded metadata.

ordinary_uploaded_result_identity.inputCrc32: Reuse leased receipt resident CRC, already equal to validated raw/declared CRC. Exact equality to legacy per-inference result.inputCrc32 for the same uploaded bytes/generation.
ordinary_uploaded_result_identity.inputSha256: Reuse exact retained declared SHA hex metadata under the existing contract. Exact equality to legacy retained declared inputSha256 for the same generation.

live_acquisition_validation_contract.ACQUISITION_GENERATION: Producer-tagged generation in the same resident ownership domain, linked to an acquisition/DMA or selected-window completion token. It is a fresh input ID, never an uploaded receipt or host content declaration.
VALID_requirements: Acquisition/DMA completion for the exact intended window and producer; selected PCM snapshot/copy and any PCM-to-float conversion complete.

Exact required sample and byte counts at every representation: current H1 waveform contract 96000 mono float32 samples, 384000 resident bytes at 32000 Hz; current PCM16 window 96000 samples/192000 bytes where applicable. Any line format/channel mapping requires its separately authorized exact contract.

Correct buffer/window/DMA ownership, stable completed resident storage, no active writer of that generation and no lease conflict. Other ring/slab buffers may acquire only without aliasing this generation.
No acquisition/conversion error and no FIFO, DMA, queue, slab or overrun error that invalidates the window; preserve applicable bounds/finite/format/channel checks.
Bind completion receipt to acquisition ID and atomically publish VALID only after quiescence and all required checks; ordinary inference uses the same timed lease contract.
live_acquisition_validation_contract.unknown_content: Unknown microphone/line content has no pre-known expected CRC/SHA/fixture. Production validity follows completion, exact counts, ownership, errors and format, never comparison to a predetermined content checksum.
live_acquisition_validation_contract.observed_fingerprints: CRC/SHA may be computed per completed generation for existing ordinary result fields, transport integrity or diagnostics. Such digests identify observed content and do not constitute expected-content validity.
live_acquisition_validation_contract.live_result_product_semantics: Keep live identity separate from upload declarations. Existing PDM calculated CRC/SHA, if exposed, remain observed generation fingerprints, never a fabricated declared SHA. Detailed future live result availability/representation and any product change require separate authorization; this freeze does not remove or change existing result fields.
live_acquisition_validation_contract.existing_PDM_writer: The source already contains PDM conversion into shared resident storage, excluded from the exact observer build. Future uploaded optimization must still cover it with minimal common invalidation/ownership hooks or STOP; adding live acquisition, changing conversion arithmetic or expanding backend scope is forbidden.
